page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-4 is an Arm-based virtual machine instance powered by Ampere AmpereOne processors. It provides 2 dedicated physical cores (2 vCPUs) running at a sustained clock speed of 3.0 GHz with single-threaded core execution. The configuration includes 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address and operates without integrated local storage or hardware GPU acceleration, requiring networked block storage volumes for persistent data.

Because the architecture assigns dedicated single-threaded execution per vCPU rather than relying on simultaneous multithreading, it delivers consistent execution without resource contention from sibling threads. With its 1:2 memory ratio and lean hardware footprint, the instance emphasizes efficient compute resource utilization for tasks that require steady processing capacity without high memory footprints.

This server profile is well matched for lightweight compute-centric tasks, microservices, containerized Arm-native workloads, dev/test environments, and low-traffic web endpoints. Environments requiring extensive in-memory caching or intensive local disk I/O will require remote volume tuning or higher-tier instance shapes.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-4 is an Arm-based compute-focused virtual machine instance powered by Ampere AmpereOne processors running at 3.0 GHz. The configuration provides 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped directly to 2 physical cores with one thread per core, paired with 4.0 GB of system memory at 2.0 GB per core. There is no integrated local storage or discrete GPU acceleration, relying on network-attached storage for disk operations. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included. Operating on single-threaded dedicated Arm cores, the instance avoids noisy-neighbor contention across hardware threads. The compact 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM balance delivers predictable execution efficiency for compute-oriented tasks without the overhead of oversized memory allocations. VM.Standard.A2.Flex.1-4 is appropriate for containerized microservices, Arm64 application development, low-traffic API hosting, and continuous integration workloads.
